q.g: In this quest you have to find a surveillance spot and obtain a flash drive on Streets of Tarkov. It can be found in room 215 on the second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building. A Pinewood hotel room 215 key is required to enter it. The flash drive has multiple spawns throughout the room.

sh.c: Spawn location 1 on the window sill next to the book
Spawn location 2 on the chest of drawers
